description: Access and Facility Roads is a dataset listed in Alberta open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Parks. The Base Features Access and Facility Roads spatial layer is the authoritative source of road data for the province of Alberta. It is a part of the Access data collection which also includes railways, powerlines, cutlines and trails, and industrial facilities. Coverage: Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Parks. Its tags are -CANADA, ACCESS, ALBERTA, FERRY, HIGHWAY. It offers 4 resource(s) in ESRI REST, HTML, OTHERS, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-alberta-portal.
